purpose: Correct the asymmetric startup timer discovered after the first strict post-change run without changing any v2 evidence or relaxing any gate.

audit.finding: The v2 legacy timer started after two implementation-owned NioEventLoopGroup constructors, while the TinyRPC timer started before its implementation-owned event-loop groups were constructed.
audit.preservation: All v1/v2 envelopes, runs, structures, and the failed first post-change result remain immutable and published as audit evidence.

implementations.legacyProductionSource: public source-equivalent baseline 27779a5; apply only the reviewed v3 measurement harness
implementations.candidateProductionSource: exact public-safe candidate commit selected after review

matchedProtocol.pairing: Run adjacent legacy/candidate pairs in one coordinated quiet window; alternate pair order AB then BA. Pair index is retained for bootstrap comparison.
matchedProtocol.failurePolicy: Do not discard or replace an unfavorable completed run. A process that fails to emit a valid record invalidates the window and is reported.

logicalPayloads.warmup: 200 sequential echo calls carrying warmup-0 through warmup-199
logicalPayloads.measurement: 1000 sequential echo calls carrying value-0 through value-999

startup.start: The first statement in main, before every implementation-owned event-loop, dispatch group, server, client, or connection is constructed.
startup.end: Immediately after the first successful readiness RPC response is validated.

idleMemory.point: After readiness and all 200 warm-up calls, followed by System.gc and a fixed 200 ms wait.
idleMemory.rss: ps -o rss= for the measured JVM PID, converted from KiB to bytes

latencyAndThroughput.point: The same 1000 sequential measured RPCs in each fresh process.
latencyAndThroughput.latency: Per-call System.nanoTime delta; report p50, p95, and p99.
latencyAndThroughput.throughput: 1000 calls divided by the enclosing measured-loop System.nanoTime delta.

statistics.memoryPass: upper95CI(candidate-minus-legacy)<0 for both idle heap and idle RSS
statistics.marginCap: Neither v3 non-inferiority margin may exceed the stricter frozen v2 value.

structuralGates.baselineDependencies: Fresh dependency:copy-dependencies with includeScope=runtime; exclude test-scoped artifacts.
structuralGates.candidateCoreArtifactBytes: strictly less than the two legacy application JARs combined
structuralGates.candidateRuntimeDependencyClosureBytes: strictly less than the unique legacy runtime-only dependency closure

publicationGate: No low-footprint, startup, or latency improvement claim is permitted until independent method review passes and every v3 runtime and structural gate passes on the exact candidate source.
